rights_holder: The producer and his label for the recording; two sampled vocalists; the individual uploaders for each video
underlying_work: Composite: a commercial recording plus tens of thousands of user videos
enforcement_history: The recording reached number one before its samples were cleared. Two artists whose vocals appear in the first thirty seconds publicly stated that they had given no permission and sought compensation from the label in 2013. The label subsequently cleared both samples. The producer separately used copyright to take down a version of the meme he objected to.
curatorial_note: The best exhibit in the collection on how memes launder provenance. The soundtrack that made tens of thousands of videos possible was itself an uncleared derivative, and the sampled artists learned about it only after the song reached number one. The museum shows no image and tells this story instead.
